crossRefs.note: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”
If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is…
“You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Yahweh will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”
He said to them, “Yahweh is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in…
Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘Yahweh is between me and…
Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord Yahweh be witness against…
Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you…
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him…
“To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s…
They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear…

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May Yahweh be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which Yahweh your God sends you to tell us.
translations.bsb: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act upon every word that the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
translations.kjv: Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the LORD thy God shall send
translations.asv: Then they said to Jeremiah, Jehovah be a true and faithful witness amongst us, if we do not according to all the word wherewith Jehovah thy God shall send thee to us.
